items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: in Clark's band, we played John Philip Sousa, and we played other marches

ctx.x: They do, in Harold Baptiste's class. Sure. And so forth. And some of the, but even, say for instance, in Clark's band, we played John Philip Sousa, and we played other marches, and everything else, overtures and so forth. I don't know what they're teaching the kids in school today.
